from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """Represents one judgment document with its title and legal cause classification."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the judgment document")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The specific legal cause of action or case category")
    case_nature: str | None = Field(description="The broad nature of the case (e.g., Civil, Criminal, Administrative, Execution)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
